title: Can two different estimates of a difference both be right?
description: Ruhee and Laksh estimate a difference near ten lakh and near nine lakh. The board subtracts in groups, checks both estimates against the result, finds whose is closer, and compares the difference with two given numbers. Keeko then raises a hand, thinking one of the two estimates is wrong.
teaching_notes: One idea: a difference lies between an estimate that is too small and one that is too big, so two different estimates can both be right. Ask the class what a bigger second number does to a difference before the estimates are checked. Watch for students who think one of two different estimates must be wrong.

source: Check the estimates of 14,63,128 − 4,90,020 by Roxie (near 10,00,000, less) and Estu (near 9,00,000, more). Say whose is closer, whether the difference is above or below 9,50,000 and 9,63,128, and find the exact difference
video_script.why: The child has trapped a sum between two estimates, and now does the same for a difference, where the second number works the other way.
video_script.substitution: Subtract in groups, check each estimate against the result, and test the difference with a bigger first number and a smaller second number.
video_script.anchor: The difference 14,63,128 − 4,90,020 with a number line from 9,00,000 to 10,00,000 under it.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sees that ten lakh and nine lakh are different and thinks one of them is wrong. The difference lies between them, so each estimate is right in its own direction.

final_answer.value: Both estimates are correct; Ruhee's is closer; more than 9,50,000; more than 9,63,128; exact difference 9,73,108
final_answer.spoken: both estimates are correct, the estimate of Ruhee is closer, the difference is more than nine lakh fifty thousand and more than nine lakh sixty three thousand one hundred twenty eight, and the exact difference is nine lakh seventy three thousand one hundred eight

names.Laksh: Eshwarappa's son, who estimates the difference near nine lakh and more
names.Ruhee: Eshwarappa's daughter, who estimates the difference near ten lakh and less

never_show: the exact difference written whole before the answer beat
maths_rules: 9,00,000 < 9,73,108 < 10,00,000, so the estimate of Roxie (less than 10,00,000) and the estimate of Estu (more than 9,00,000) are both correct
14,63,128 is more than 14,50,000 and 4,90,020 is less than 5,00,000, so the difference is more than 14,50,000 − 5,00,000 = 9,50,000
9,63,128 = 14,63,128 − 5,00,000; 4,90,020 is less than 5,00,000, so we take away less and the difference is more than 9,63,128
video_script.design: One idea: the difference lies between two estimates, so both can be right. Wrong idea: Keeko says one of two different estimates is wrong. The anchor stays all video; the working band builds in the idea part; no hard clear.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: subtract in groups: 128 − 20 = 108; 63 thousand − 90 thousand needs a borrow: 14 lakh becomes 13 lakh, 63 becomes 163; 163 − 90 = 73 thousand; 13 − 4 = 9 lakh

marks.m2: a borrow of one lakh is shown from 14 lakh to 13 lakh, and 63 becomes 163

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, subtract in groups. One hundred twenty eight minus twenty is one hundred eight.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Sixty three thousand is too small to take away ninety thousand, so we borrow one lakh.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Then one hundred sixty three thousand minus ninety thousand is seventy three thousand. Thirteen lakh minus four lakh is nine lakh.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: 9 lakh and more, but less than 10 lakh: both estimates correct. Distance below 10,00,000: 26,892. Distance above 9,00,000: 73,108. 26,892 is smaller

marks.m1: the difference is marked between 9,00,000 and 10,00,000 on the number line

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, the difference is more than nine lakh and less than ten lakh.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Ruhee says less than ten lakh, and Laksh says more than nine lakh. Both are correct.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Ten lakh minus the difference is twenty six thousand eight hundred ninety two.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>The difference minus nine lakh is seventy three thousand one hundred eight.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>The smaller distance is from ten lakh, so Ruhee is closer.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: first > 14,50,000 and second < 5,00,000, so the difference > 14,50,000 − 5,00,000 = 9,50,000. 9,63,128 = 14,63,128 − 5,00,000; second < 5,00,000, so we take away less and the difference > 9,63,128
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, the first number is more than fourteen lakh fifty thousand. The second is less than five lakh.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Fourteen lakh fifty thousand minus five lakh is nine lakh fifty thousand. The difference is more than nine lakh fifty thousand.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Nine lakh sixty three thousand one hundred twenty eight is the first number minus five lakh.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>The second number is less than five lakh, so we take away less. The difference is more than that.

beats.on_screen: Answer: both estimates correct; Ruhee is closer; difference > 9,50,000; difference > 9,63,128; exact difference = 9,73,108
